claimLedger.claim: ASRM endorsed renaming PCOS to Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome (PMOS).
claimLedger.sourceSection: ASRM · PCOS is Now PMOS: Understanding the Name Change · 27 May 2026
claimLedger.limitations: Name adoption across Indian records and insurers may lag.

claimLedger.claim: Adults: two of three features after exclusions, with AMH as alternative to ultrasound for PCOM; adolescents: both irregular cycles and hyperandrogenism; ultrasound/AMH not for diagnosis within 8 years of menarche; exclude thyroid disease, hyperprolactinaemia, non-classic CAH.
claimLedger.sourceSection: Monash MCHRI / International Guideline Consortium · International evidence-based guideline for the assessment and management of polycystic ovary syndrome / PMOS (2023 full guideline PDF) · 2023 guideline (PMOS name update noted on Monash hub May 2026)
claimLedger.limitations: International guideline; local test availability and laboratory AMH cut-offs vary.

claimLedger.claim: Restates adult two-of-three criteria including AMH alternative; adolescents require both hyperandrogenism and ovulatory dysfunction; ultrasound and AMH not recommended in adolescents.
claimLedger.sourceSection: Medical Journal of Australia · Summary of the 2023 international evidence-based guideline for the assessment and management of polycystic ovary syndrome: an Australian perspective · Published online 23 September 2024
claimLedger.limitations: Australian implementation lens; regulatory status of medicines discussed elsewhere differs by country.
